title: Clostridium Difficile Disease Severity Score (Hines VA)

groups.key: cat scan findings of colonic wall thickening dilated colon o
groups.label: CAT scan findings of colonic wall thickening, dilated colon, or ascites

bands.label: Mild to moderate disease
bands.raw: 0 to 2 points: Mild to moderate disease

notes: In the Belmares study, patients with a score of 3 or more were more likely to fail metronidazole treatment.
content.data_input_disclaimer: ONLY DIGITS 0 TO 9 AND A SINGLE DECIMAL POINT (".") ARE ACCEPTABLE AS NUMERIC INPUTS. ATTEMPTED INPUT OF OTHER CHARACTERS INTO A NUMERIC FIELD MAY LEAD TO AN INCORRECT RESULT.

references.text: Belmares J, Gerding DN, Parada JP, et al. Outcome of metronidazole therapy for Clostridium difficile disease and correlation with a scoring system. J Infect. 2007 Dec;55(6):495-501.[PubMed 17983659]
Fujitani S, George WL, Murthy AR. Comparison of clinical severity score indices for Clostridium difficile infection. Infect Control Hosp Epidemiol. 2011 Mar;32(3):220-8. [PubMed 21460506]
